free_text_notes.physician_note: 79-year-old man with alcohol use disorder in remission, asthma, admitted 3/1 with left lower lobe pneumonia with small parapneumonic effusion. Oxygen weaned to room air yesterday. Pulse oximetry briefly read 94 percent during a deep sleep period overnight. Daytime readings have consistently been above 96 percent and no clinical concern was raised.
